metadata.question: Was the nightime brightness in San Juan lower on September 27-28, 2017 than September 1-2, 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NASA Black Marble daily VIIRS (NASA/BlackMarble/VNP46A2/V001) over a San Juan ROI (15 km buffer around downtown). Compare two windows: 2017-09-01 to 2017-09-03 vs 2017-09-27 to 2017-09-29. If a window has zero images, expand by ±2 days.
2. Masking strategy: Use VNP46A2 Cloud_Mask (clear/probably clear: <=1). Analyze the DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL band at 1000 m scale.
3. Validity: If collections empty -> C1. If valid pixels after masking equal 0 -> C2. If mean is null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise compare later < earlier to answer.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([-66.1057, 18.4655]).buffer(15000); // San Juan, ~15 km buffer
    const earlyStart = '2017-09-01';
    const earlyEnd = '2017-09-03';   // end-exclusive
    const lateStart = '2017-09-27';
    const lateEnd = '2017-09-29';    // end-exclusive

    const datasetId = 'NASA/BlackMarble/VNP46A2/V001';
    const bandName = 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL';
    const cloudBand = 'Cloud_Mask';
    const scale = 1000;

    function maskAndSelect(img) {
      const ntl = img.select(bandName).rename('NTL');
      const cm = img.select(cloudBand);
      const clear = cm.lte(1); // 0=Clear, 1=Probably Clear
      return ntl.updateMask(clear);
    }

    function getWindowStats(startStr, endStr, label) {
      // Primary 2-day window
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
        .filterBounds(roi)
        .filterDate(startStr, endStr);
      let size = col.size();
      const sizeVal = size.getInfo();

      // If empty, expand window by ±2 days
      let usedExpanded = false;
      if (sizeVal === 0) {
        const start = ee.Date(startStr).advance(-2, 'day');
        const end = ee.Date(endStr).advance(2, 'day');
        col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
          .filterBounds(roi)
          .filterDate(start, end);
        const sizeVal2 = col.size().getInfo();
        usedExpanded = true;
        if (sizeVal2 === 0) {
          return { status: 'C1', label, nImages: 0 };
        }
      }

      const proc = col.map(maskAndSelect);
      const mosaic = proc.median();

      const totalPx = ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('one').getInfo();

      const validPx = mosaic.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NTL').getInfo();

      if (!validPx || validPx === 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', label, nImages: (usedExpanded ? col.size().getInfo() : sizeVal), totalPx, validPx: validPx || 0 };
      }

      const meanVal = mosaic.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('NTL').getInfo();

      if (meanVal === null || Number.isNaN(meanVal)) {
        return { status: 'C3', label };
      }

      const nImgs = col.size().getInfo();
      const cloudPct = totalPx ? (100 * (1 - validPx / totalPx)) : null;

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        label,
        nImages: nImgs,
        usedExpanded,
        totalPx,
        validPx,
        cloudPct: cloudPct !== null ? +(cloudPct.toFixed(1)) : null,
        mean: meanVal
      };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const early = getWindowStats(earlyStart, earlyEnd, 'Sep 1-2, 2017');
    const late = getWindowStats(lateStart, lateEnd, 'Sep 27-28, 2017');

    // Handle error cases
    if (early.status !== 'OK' || late.status !== 'OK') {
      // Print concise diagnostics
      if (early.status !== 'OK') {
        console.log(`Early (${early.label}): ${early.status}${early.nImages !== undefined ? `, Images: ${early.nImages}` : ''}${early.validPx !== undefined ? `, ValidPx: ${early.validPx}` : ''}`);
      } else {
        console.log(`Early (${early.label}): Images: ${early.nImages}, ValidPx: ${early.validPx}/${early.totalPx}, Cloud%: ${early.cloudPct}%, MeanNTL: ${early.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
      }
      if (late.status !== 'OK') {
        console.log(`Late (${late.label}): ${late.status}${late.nImages !== undefined ? `, Images: ${late.nImages}` : ''}${late.validPx !== undefined ? `, ValidPx: ${late.validPx}` : ''}`);
      } else {
        console.log(`Late (${late.label}): Images: ${late.nImages}, ValidPx: ${late.validPx}/${late.totalPx}, Cloud%: ${late.cloudPct}%, MeanNTL: ${late.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
      }
      const tag = (early.status === 'C1' || late.status === 'C1') ? 'C1'
                 : (early.status === 'C2' || late.status === 'C2') ? 'C2'
                 : 'C3';
      console.log(tag);
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & 4. Calculation: Already done above

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Early (${early.label}): Images: ${early.nImages}${early.usedExpanded ? ' [expanded]' : ''}, ValidPx: ${early.validPx}/${early.totalPx} (Cloud%: ${early.cloudPct}%), MeanNTL: ${early.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`Late (${late.label}): Images: ${late.nImages}${late.usedExpanded ? ' [expanded]' : ''}, ValidPx: ${late.validPx}/${late.totalPx} (Cloud%: ${late.cloudPct}%), MeanNTL: ${late.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    const delta = late.mean - early.mean;
    console.log(`Delta (late - early): ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);

    if (Number.isNaN(delta)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Answer: Was late lower than early?
    if (delta < 0) {
      console.log('A'); // Yes
    } else {
      console.log('B'); // No
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected error (e.g., dataset/band issues)
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
